intro_html: Taco soup is what happens when taco night gets practical. Ground turkey, kidney beans, sweet corn and a tomato base seasoned like a taco, thinned into something you can eat with a spoon and pack into containers. A little sour cream on top and a scoop of rice underneath turns it into a full plate. Seven main ingredients, one pot, and almost nothing on the receipt.
cost_closing_html: About $3.04 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a spiced, bean-loaded dinner with sour cream on top. Cans and rice are doing the work here, and cans and rice are cheap.
shop_smart: Canned beans and canned corn are the whole base. Watch the case price, buy deep when it drops, and you have the bones of this soup on the shelf for a year.
Make your own taco seasoning from pantry jars. The little packets cost more per ounce than almost anything else in the store, and it is chili powder, cumin, onion powder and salt you already own.
Tomato sauce, not salsa or diced tomatoes. Plain tomato sauce is the cheapest tomato in the aisle and it gives this soup the smooth body it needs.
Light sour cream is a topping, not an ingredient. Add it to each container at reheat time instead of stirring it into the pot, and it will not break or go watery in the fridge.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice separately per the package and set it aside covered.
Brown the ground turkey in the vegetable oil in your big pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up until it is cooked through.
Stir in the taco seasoning, onion powder, salt and black pepper and let them toast against the hot pan for a minute.
Pour in the tomato sauce and the chicken broth and bring it to a simmer.
Add the drained kidney beans and the drained sweet corn along with the touch of sugar-free maple syrup, which balances the acid in the tomato.
Simmer 20 minutes so the flavors settle, then taste and adjust the salt. Keep the sour cream on the side.
portion_html: Spread the cooked rice into your 14 containers, then set the soup pot on your scale, subtract the empty pot weight from Step 1, divide by 14, and ladle that exact weight over the rice. Every serving lands near 619 calories with 35 grams of protein once the sour cream goes on at reheat.

head.description: Ground turkey, kidney beans and sweet corn in a taco-spiced tomato broth over rice. A 14 serving one pot soup built for cheap meal prep.

steps: Cook the rice separately and set it aside.
Brown the ground turkey in vegetable oil, then toast the taco seasoning in the pot.
Add the tomato sauce and chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the drained kidney beans, corn and a touch of sugar-free maple syrup.
Simmer 20 minutes, serve over rice, and top with light sour cream.
